Package dev.turboism.sdk.cubism.transaction

Interface AuthoringTransactionService

All Known Implementing Classes:
AuthoringTransactionService.Unavailable
@CubismEditor(from="5.0.00") public interface AuthoringTransactionService
Executes one synchronous callback inside a Runtime-owned Editor authoring transaction.

The implementation owns host-thread admission, active document/model binding, native Undo grouping, abort and recovery, and transaction diagnostics. The callback receives no transaction handle and may interact only through normal SDK services available to the plugin.

This is the one recommended transaction entry for plugin writes. Use it when several writes must commit or roll back together or share a single Undo entry; a lone Parameter.setValue call needs no transaction wrapper.

The callback runs on the host's UI thread (the Cubism Editor Swing event dispatch thread). It must be brief and must not block or wait for other UI-thread tasks — doing so deadlocks the host. SDK writes inside the callback that produce an admissible native Undo object — both coordinator-backed writes such as Parameter.setValue and the migrated hand-written Undo envelopes — join the ambient transaction's single Undo group and commit or roll back with it. SDK writes whose native Undo cannot be admitted to the ambient edit (animation timeline writes, parameter-definition updates, writes that explicitly bypass history) reject with a typed failure instead of creating detached Undo state.

    • batchStoredSourceWrites

      default void batchStoredSourceWrites(Runnable work)
      Groups stored-source writes behind one synchronous instance-evaluation barrier.

      Call only within an active authoring transaction, for parameter bindings and ordinary ArtMesh keyform batches and stored ArtMesh draw-order scalars (including the default form). The callback may read stored authoring snapshots; it must not reparent objects, access evaluated geometry, change parameter values, or perform texture operations. Instances are current again before this method returns, including when the callback throws. Native Undo and readback remain per write. Implementations without this optimization execute the callback normally.

      Parameters:
      work - synchronous stored-source writes; must not start a nested batch
